instruction: Set the title font size to 32 points or larger on the current slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing the title font size to at least 32 points. The custom getter extracts the font size of the title text. The metric checks if the font size is greater than or equal to 32 points.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies title shape using PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE (pptx.py:38), which is a structural/semantic approach that works generically for any PowerPoint file, not relying on hardcoded text content.
Metric correctly compares font size >= 32 points using expected.get('min_font_size_pt'), properly handling the expected parameter as the rules dictionary (not nested under 'rules' key).
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts font size from title → Metric verifies size >= 32 → Returns 1.0 or 0.0.
Postconfig correctly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring changes are persisted to disk.

Minor: Getter extracts font size from first non-empty run (pptx.py:46-52). If title has multiple runs with different sizes, only first is checked. However, for typical title shapes with uniform formatting, this is acceptable.
Minor: Getter reads prs.slides[0] rather than truly 'active' slide. Given task setup (opens specific single-slide file), this is acceptable in context.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: To handle titles with mixed font sizes, could iterate all runs and check if any/all meet the minimum requirement, or take the minimum/maximum/average font size across runs.
